import pytest

from csvstats import column_stats


def test_full_summary(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "d.csv"
    p.write_text("a,b\n1,x\n2,y\n3,z\n4,w\n")
    s = column_stats(p, "a")
    assert s["count"] == 4 and isinstance(s["count"], int)
    assert s["mean"] == 2.5
    assert s["median"] == 2.5
    assert s["min"] == 1.0 and s["max"] == 4.0
    assert s["stdev"] == pytest.approx(1.2909944487)
    assert all(isinstance(s[k], float) for k in ("mean", "median", "min", "max", "stdev"))

    p = tmp_path / "d.csv"

    s = column_stats(p, "a")
    assert s["count"] == 1 and s["stdev"] == 0.0 and s["median"] == 7.0
